topic: Data pipeline setup and testing strategy
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on setting up a data pipeline, specifically involving daily additions of processed data. It was decided that the process should run after recalculation and aggregation.

To test skills, it was proposed to give candidates access to a demographics page containing filters and graphs (by gender, age groups, and income). Candidates should be asked to recreate these elements using provided sample JSON data, with a suggested testing period of 10-15 hours. The quality of the candidate's work, particularly their ability to reuse existing dashboards, will be an indicator of performance.

Regarding the technical setup, [me] confirmed that the necessary components are available in the repository (vex). It was determined that a date filter is required for data ingestion, and specific SQL logic (`session_start_hour >= toStartOfDay(now())`) was agreed upon to ensure only yesterday's data is processed.
decisions: The daily data addition job should run after recalculation and aggregation.
Candidates will be tasked with recreating the demographics page using provided filters, graphs (by gender, age groups, income), and sample JSON data.
A date filter must be implemented for data ingestion to ensure only yesterday's data is processed.
action_items: [p1] will generate VPN configs and a setup guide/table for the process.
[p1] will schedule the script to run on the 03 server in the morning.
